background: The Northern Trust Company is the operating bank of Northern Trust, a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager whose business is asset servicing for institutions and banking for wealthy families rather than mass-market lending.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- from Fitch, AA- from S&P and A2 from Moody's, all stable. Capital is mixed against US peers: CET1 of 11.8% is in the bottom quarter against the peer median, while leverage of 6.8% is in the top quarter against 5.8%. LCR of 107% is in the bottom quarter against 117%, though a custody balance sheet is built differently from a lender's. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. A conservative fee-earning bank with high ratings and modest ratio headroom.
